screen.blockcinema.agreement.title: YouTube on Block Cinema
screen.blockcinema.agreement.subtitle: Before YouTube plays for you
screen.blockcinema.agreement.body: Block Cinema plays YouTube videos with YouTube's official embedded player, which uses YouTube API Services. By using Block Cinema's YouTube features, you agree to be bound by the YouTube Terms of Service. YouTube's player collects some information, as the Google Privacy Policy describes. Block Cinema's privacy policy explains what the mod keeps on your computer and shares; it collects nothing itself. Until you agree, YouTube TVs show a notice instead of the video.
